editorial:
Imagine being an orphan who talks non-stop and has a wild imagination, only to find out the family who adopted you actually wanted a boy to help on the farm. That is exactly what happens to Anne Shirley. You will quickly fall in love with her spirit as she crashes into the quiet lives of Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert. The movie feels like a warm hug, taking you to the beautiful countryside of Prince Edward Island. It is a sweet story about finding where you belong and making a family out of people who didn't expect to love you.

The acting is just wonderful, especially since Anne feels like a real kid and not a caricature. While the pace is slow and relaxing, it never feels boring because you are rooting for Anne to fit in. If you want something heartwarming, this is it. It is the perfect pick for a cozy night in with your family or a rainy afternoon when you just need a feel-good story.
endingExplained: After years of growing up and studying, Anne becomes a teacher. However, tragedy hits when Matthew passes away, leaving Marilla alone and struggling with her sight. To help her aunt, Anne gives up her scholarship to stay at home and teach nearby. She also makes peace with her old rival, Gilbert, and they finally become close friends. It ends with Anne choosing love and family over her own big ambitions.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic stories about friendship and growing up.
